rationale: The agent made several redundant calls to `get_files_info` and `get_file_content` after it had already established that `calculator.py` was not present and that there were no subdirectories. Specifically, it re-listed files in iteration 3 after already doing so in iteration 1, and re-read `sample.csv` in iteration 3 after it was clear that the file was not relevant to finding `calculator.py`.
